description:
Return exactly what this server covers and the limits it enforces. Call this first, or whenever a query comes back empty and you want to know whether the filing type is even in scope, before concluding the data is incomplete.

It takes no arguments and does not touch the database, so it works even when everything else is degraded. Coverage is deliberately narrow and expanding over time; the `event_types` list in the response is the authoritative answer, and stating it plainly is preferable to letting you discover the boundary by trial and error. Read `limits` instead of probing for the caps.
name: list_coverage

outputSchema.description: What this server covers and the limits it enforces.

expanding.description: True: more filing types are being added over time.
expanding.title: Expanding

limits.description: Server-side caps. Read them instead of discovering them by hitting walls.
limits.title: Limits
